---
title: "Downloads & Replication"
---

Everything published here is the CONDLA team's own work: the coded dataset and its indices, the codebook, and the script that computes them. We do not publish the primary sources (legislation, operational manuals, press clippings) used to code each program.

## Files

- [**Dataset (CSV, 336×49)**](data/condla_indices.csv) — `condla_indices.csv`: the 36 coded variables plus the 4 severity indices and 5 vagueness indices, documented in [Codebook & Methodology](codebook.qmd).
- [**Full codebook (PDF)**](descargas/CONDLA_indices_codebook_v1.pdf) — `CONDLA_indices_codebook_v1.pdf`: the definition of every one of the 49 columns and the mathematical derivation of the indices.
- [**Replication script (Quarto/R)**](descargas/Script_publicable_CONDLA_v1.qmd) — `Script_publicable_CONDLA_v1.qmd`: rebuilds the 9 index columns from the 36 coded variables.

Questions, or requests for the underlying database (before it was reduced to the analytical sample): please contact the researchers, see [Team](equipo.qmd).
